nodes.name: bot.py
nodes.summary: Telegram bot setup and lifecycle management. Configures command handlers, message handlers, voice/audio handlers, and callback query handlers. Provides text chunking for Telegram's 4096-char limit, voice-to-text TTS integration, and BotSignal sender registration for both regular and voice modes.

nodes.name: _chunk_text
nodes.summary: Splits long text into chunks respecting Telegram's character limit, preferring breaks at newlines or spaces.

nodes.name: create_bot
nodes.summary: Creates and configures the Telegram bot application with command, message, voice, and callback handlers.

nodes.name: bind_runtime
nodes.summary: Binds runtime objects (orchestrator, botsignal) and registers Telegram senders for regular text and voice modes.

nodes.name: run_bot
nodes.summary: Creates and runs the Telegram bot using long-polling (blocking).

nodes.name: command.py
nodes.summary: Telegram bot command handlers. Implements /start, /help, /status, /about commands, plus message handling that dispatches to the shared MessageOrchestrator. Includes voice message transcription via transcribe_audio and callback query handling for inline keyboard buttons.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Handles /start command - greets user and shows keyboard options.

nodes.name: help_command
nodes.summary: Handles /help command - shows available commands.

nodes.name: handle_message
nodes.summary: Handles incoming text messages and dispatches to the shared MessageOrchestrator via IncomingRequest.

nodes.name: handle_voice_message
nodes.summary: Transcribes received voice/audio notes and passes them to the orchestrator.

nodes.name: discordapp.py
nodes.summary: Discord bot connector using discord.py. Extends discord.Client with message handling, audio attachment transcription, text chunking for Discord's 2000-char limit, and BotSignal sender registration. Supports message content intent as opt-in.

nodes.name: DiscordBot
nodes.summary: Discord bot class extending discord.Client with SARAS-specific message handling, voice transcription, text chunking, and BotSignal integration.

nodes.name: slackapp.py
nodes.summary: Slack bot connector using Slack Bolt AsyncApp with Socket Mode. Handles message and app_mention events, transcribes audio attachments, sends replies in-thread, supports file uploads for long text, and registers with BotSignal for outbound delivery.

nodes.name: SlackBot
nodes.summary: Slack bot class using Bolt AsyncApp with Socket Mode for message handling, transcription, and BotSignal integration.

nodes.name: whatsappapp.py
nodes.summary: WhatsApp connector via Baileys HTTP bridge. Exposes FastAPI routes for incoming messages from the bridge, sends outbound messages by POSTing to the bridge's /send endpoint. Includes health check endpoint and BotSignal sender registration.

nodes.name: WhatsAppBot
nodes.summary: WhatsApp bot connector bridging to Baileys Node.js process via HTTP.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI web dashboard server (1570 lines). Provides REST API, WebSocket chat/voice/event streams, life dashboard routes (finance/health/habits), system health monitoring, agent/tool listing, knowledge graph management, session management, MCP integration, provider management, config editing, and Hermes-class server-rendered pages with HTMX. Major entry point for all web-based interactions.

nodes.name: WebDashboard
nodes.summary: FastAPI-based web dashboard acting as a SARAS platform connector with REST API, WebSocket chat, voice streaming, and system monitoring.

nodes.name: broadcast_event
nodes.summary: Pushes system events to all /ws/events WebSocket subscribers.

nodes.name: life_dashboard.py
nodes.summary: Framework-agnostic REST surface for personal-life trackers (Finance, Health, Habits). Provides a dispatch-table router pattern that returns plain dicts, enabling reuse across FastAPI, Streamlit, and test environments without framework dependencies.

nodes.name: LifeDashboardRouter
nodes.summary: Dispatch-table router for life-dashboard REST surface (finance, health, habits). Framework-agnostic, returns plain dicts.

nodes.name: daemon.py
nodes.summary: Gateway daemon managing all channel lifecycle. Replaces monolithic main.py startup with modular daemon that starts/stops/restarts channels independently, tracks health, auto-reconnects on failure, and provides status reporting. Includes PID file management for systemd integration.

nodes.name: GatewayDaemon
nodes.summary: Persistent gateway daemon managing all channel lifecycle with auto-restart, health monitoring, and PID file management.

nodes.name: session_router.py
nodes.summary: Routes channels to isolated agent sessions. Different channels or chat groups can be routed to different agent personas via configurable routing rules stored in workspace/config/routing.json. Supports session prefix overrides and agent-specific routing.

nodes.name: SessionRouter
nodes.summary: Routes channels/accounts to isolated agent sessions with configurable routing rules.

nodes.name: RoutingRule
nodes.summary: Dataclass defining a routing rule mapping a channel to an agent and session with priority.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM models for SARAS persistent storage. Defines User (platform identity), Memory (FACT/RULE/TOOL_GUIDE with vector embeddings), and ScheduledTask (cron-based reminders) tables.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy model for platform users with timezone and language preferences.

nodes.name: Memory
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy model for memories with category (FACT/RULE/TOOL_GUIDE), content, and optional vector embeddings.

nodes.name: ScheduledTask
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy model for scheduled tasks with cron expressions and next run times.

nodes.name: session.py
nodes.summary: Async SQLAlchemy engine and session factory. Provides get_engine(), get_session_factory(), and init_db() for creating all tables. Defaults to SQLite with aiosqlite fallback.

nodes.name: get_engine
nodes.summary: Returns or creates the global async SQLAlchemy engine singleton.

nodes.name: init_db
nodes.summary: Creates all database tables (development/SQLite fallback).

nodes.name: helix.py
nodes.summary: HelixDB Python async HTTP client for the AetherRavyn graph+vector store. Single abstraction over HelixDB providing typed async API, connection retry with fallback, health probes, and query execution (read/write). Includes query AST builders for constructing HelixDB query envelopes.

nodes.name: HelixClient
nodes.summary: Async client for local HelixDB gateway with retry, fallback, health probes, and query execution.

nodes.name: HelixHealth
nodes.summary: Result of a HelixDB health probe with latency and error info.

nodes.name: QueryResult
nodes.summary: Single query invocation result with data dict, latency, and request type.

nodes.name: knowledge_graph_helix.py
nodes.summary: HelixDB-backed knowledge graph (Phase B). Denormalized graph storing entities with outgoing edges as JSON properties. Supports add_relationship, query_entity, find_path (BFS), list_entities, and get_stats. Replaces Neo4j backend when KG_BACKEND=helix is set.

nodes.name: HelixKnowledgeGraph
nodes.summary: Denormalized knowledge graph stored in HelixDB with add_relationship, query_entity, and find_path (BFS).

nodes.name: memory_helix.py
nodes.summary: HelixDB-backed semantic memory store (Phase B). Stores memories as nodes with 384-dim embeddings from all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Supports save (deduplicates by content hash), retrieve (cosine similarity), and count. Includes sync facade over async API and hash-based embedding fallback for tests.

nodes.name: HelixMemoryStore
nodes.summary: Semantic memory store backed by HelixDB nodes with 384-dim embeddings and cosine similarity retrieval.

nodes.name: knowledge_manager.py
nodes.summary: Structured facade over the knowledge graph (Phase 4 v9). Synchronous API for record_fact, record_facts, query, find_path, and sync_from_life_context. JSONL fallback when HelixDB/Neo4j unavailable. Includes async event-loop bridge for calling async KG tools from sync context.

nodes.name: KnowledgeManager
nodes.summary: Synchronous facade over the knowledge graph with JSONL fallback for record_fact, query, and find_path.

nodes.name: Fact
nodes.summary: Dataclass for a single (subject, predicate, object) triple with source and timestamp.

nodes.name: scheduler.py
nodes.summary: SARAS task scheduler wrapping APScheduler with SQLite persistence. Provides SarasScheduler class for scheduling one-shot or recurring reminders via add_reminder, cancel_reminder, and list_reminders. Uses APScheduler AsyncIOScheduler with SQLAlchemyJobStore.

nodes.name: SarasScheduler
nodes.summary: Legacy task scheduler wrapping APScheduler with SQLite persistence for reminders and cron jobs.

nodes.name: scheduler.py
nodes.summary: Scheduler facade (Day 21) tying ScheduleRegistry, RoutineRegistry, pluggable clock, and fire callback. Supports cron, interval, event, and one-shot triggers. Pure tick() for testing, async run_forever() for production. Publishes Signals from routines through a signal router.

nodes.name: Scheduler
nodes.summary: In-process scheduler with pluggable clock + fire callback, supporting cron/interval/event triggers and signal publishing.

nodes.name: FiredSchedule
nodes.summary: Record of one schedule firing on a tick with routine_id and user_id properties.

nodes.name: planner.py
nodes.summary: Rule-based + LLM-augmented planner. Turns user goals into TaskPlans via classify (regex/keyword match) → template → estimate → validate pipeline. Falls back to LLM when confidence is low. Supports goal kinds: greeting, time_query, status_query, file_read/write, code_task, research, shell_task, reminder.

nodes.name: Planner
nodes.summary: Builds TaskPlan objects from free-text goals using rule-based classification with optional LLM augmentation.

nodes.name: GoalKind
nodes.summary: Enum of coarse goal taxonomy: GREETING, TIME_QUERY, STATUS_QUERY, FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, CODE_TASK, RESEARCH, SHELL_TASK, REMINDER, UNKNOWN.

nodes.name: executor.py
nodes.summary: Plan executor with retry, parallel groups, and checkpointing. Executes TaskPlan steps via tool/llm/ask_user/wait/subplan dispatchers. Supports parallel step groups, step-level retries with backoff, timeouts, and plan persistence via PlanStore. Sub-plan recursion with dedicated executor support.

nodes.name: PlanExecutor
nodes.summary: Executes TaskPlan steps with retries, parallel groups, and checkpointing via tool/llm/ask_user/subplan dispatchers.

nodes.name: ExecutionResult
nodes.summary: Result of plan execution with step_results and success/failure properties.

nodes.name: morning_briefing.py
nodes.summary: Morning briefing routine composing JARVIS-style daily briefings. Gathers real context (devices, tasks, weather, evidence), synthesizes via LLM, and delivers through proactive engine or legacy direct-send path. Supports both legacy APScheduler and v2 Scheduler registration.

nodes.name: compose_morning_briefing
nodes.summary: Composes a JARVIS-style morning briefing using real context (devices, tasks, weather) and LLM synthesis.

nodes.name: register_morning_briefing
nodes.summary: Registers morning briefing cron job, dispatching to v2 scheduler or legacy APScheduler path.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Default routine registration on the v2 scheduler. Aggregates morning briefing, evening review, weekly digest, anomaly digest, calendar watcher, internet watcher, and autonomy worker into a single register_default_routines call.

nodes.name: register_default_routines
nodes.summary: Registers every built-in routine (morning, evening, weekly, anomaly) for one user on the v2 scheduler.

nodes.name: register_default_signals
nodes.summary: Registers watcher routines (calendar, internet, autonomy) on IntervalTrigger schedules with signal router.

nodes.name: orchestrator.py
nodes.summary: PrivacyManager facade tying detection, redaction, consent, and retention. Provides redact_text, check_consent, schedule_retention, purge_due, delete_user, and async persistence mirror for HelixDB. Thread-safe with in-memory defaults.

nodes.name: PrivacyManager
nodes.summary: Process-level facade for privacy package: detection, redaction, consent, and retention with async HelixDB persistence mirror.

nodes.name: PrivacyConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration dataclass for privacy manager with default policies, IP detection flag, and retention policy.

nodes.name: PrivacyError
nodes.summary: PermissionError subclass raised when privacy/consent check refuses an operation.

nodes.name: citations.py
nodes.summary: Trust & Explainability: Citations system. Data model for traceable facts with CitationSource (MEMORY/FILE/WEB/TOOL/GRAPH/USER/INFERENCE), Citation, CitedFact, and CitationManager. Renderer inserts [1]/[2] markers and appends sources list. Thread-safe with deduplication.

nodes.name: CitationManager
nodes.summary: Process-level facade for citations with registration, rendering, and lookup. Thread-safe with deduplication.

nodes.name: Citation
nodes.summary: Immutable dataclass for a single source backing a fact with source kind, reference, title, and snippet.

nodes.name: CitationSource
nodes.summary: Enum of citation source kinds: MEMORY, FILE, WEB, TOOL, GRAPH, USER, INFERENCE.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing AetherRavyn tools over stdio JSON-RPC transport. Implements initialize, tools/list, and tools/call handlers. Wraps BaseTool instances as MCP-compatible tool descriptors with JSON Schema input formats.

nodes.name: MCPServer
nodes.summary: MCP server exposing AetherRavyn tools over stdio JSON-RPC with initialize/tools/list/tools/call handlers.

nodes.name: MCPToolDescriptor
nodes.summary: MCP-compatible tool descriptor with name, description, and input_schema.

nodes.name: manager.py
nodes.summary: MCP dynamic tool discovery — loads tools from configured MCP servers via stdio transport. MCPManager connects to multiple servers concurrently, discovers their tools, and wraps each in MCPToolAdapter (BaseTool) for AgentRuntime registration.

nodes.name: MCPManager
nodes.summary: Connects to multiple MCP servers concurrently and exposes their tools as BaseTool adapters.

nodes.name: MCPToolAdapter
nodes.summary: Wraps an MCP tool as a BaseTool for AgentRuntime integration.
